Nothing is invented: fields the store does not publish (price, rarity, release date) stay empty. Names and images belong to Double Eleven and Facepunch; Spinback RCE is not affiliated with them and sells nothing.

fields.name: the skin or product name as the store shows it

fields.description: the product page's own summary text
fields.gallery: the other images on the product page
fields.contents: the individual skins listed inside the pack, with images where the page shows them
fields.stores: whether the product page links to the PlayStation and Xbox stores
